intervals.label: collaboration: data taking at the Antiproton Decelerator
intervals.note: Start is a lower bound: the CERN Courier of 17 August 2000 reports the AD "coming into action for physics" and supplying ATRAP, ATHENA and ASACUSA; the experiment's own first-data date is not stated in a source consulted. The end of ATRAP data taking is not dated in any source consulted (the active interval is closed at the same upper bound as the completed one); CERN's AD page says "ATRAP and ACE have now completed their experiments" (undated), whereas the older CERN ATRAP page says "ATRAP is still in operation".
intervals.quote: This is the motivation behind CERN’s new AD, which supplies antiprotons to several experiments – ATRAP (son of TRAP at LEAR), ATHENA and ASACUSA.

intervals.label: collaboration: completed (true end date not published; upper bound)
intervals.note: UPPER BOUND ONLY. The AD page states that ATRAP has completed but gives no date; the date used is the day the Antimatter Factory stopped for LS3, by which time ATRAP is no longer listed as running. The real end of ATRAP data taking is earlier and unknown (unresolved).
intervals.quote: Whereas ATRAP and ACE have now completed their experiments.
